whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Game Zone Patna,

I noticed your gaming zone has a prime location on Bailey Road in Shastri Nagar, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for bookings and party inquiries.

Maine aapke game zone ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp game booking, VR/arcade game showcase, aur party packages integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gamezone

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Game Zone Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and game package highlights for your location on Bailey Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
